title: Barbara:
length: about 85 s (about 75 s without the “cut first” row)
headline: A Keya House peer with three years on the job tells anyone who doubts they can get better: there is always hope. Reach out.
story: Barbara Schmidt has been a peer support specialist at Keya House for three years. Peer support is not clinical: “We just talk to people and relate to people and share our experiences.” She has never had a job like this one, and she has seen people do amazing things.
Her message is simple: there is always hope, and if you reach out, there is plenty of support. It must feel warm, calm and hopeful. This video is about her and her message, not about the house.
